title: Ramp footer
description: A near-black footer: six link columns (company links in white, then titled groups in 60% grey), a hairline, then fine print with underlined legal links, an address, app-store and social links, and a dark email bar with an acid-lime button. On phones the titled groups fold into chevron rows.
notes: forces the theme's dark colours with the dark class
tuck pulls it up under a rounded band above it (ramp-cta)
phone accordions are native <details>, no JavaScript
